research_question: Can we assume Microsoft’s AI capacity catches up with near-term demand by June 2025?

records.statement: Management expected AI capacity to roughly match near-term demand by the end of FY2025.
records.source_locator: Amy Hood prepared remarks: Azure outlook; search for “roughly in line”.
records.speaker: Amy Hood, CFO

records.statement: Management revised its outlook to include some AI capacity constraints beyond June.
records.source_locator: Amy Hood prepared remarks: Azure capacity outlook; search for “constraints beyond June”.
records.speaker: Amy Hood, CFO

records.statement: Management expected capacity constraints to continue through the first half of the next fiscal year.
records.source_locator: Amy Hood outlook: Intelligent Cloud / Azure; search for “capacity constrained through”.
records.speaker: Amy Hood, CFO

assessment.interpretation: The June catch-up assumption should be revisited: later management statements describe continuing constraints. These are changing expectations, not verified delivery outcomes.
not_established: Whether capacity actually caught up by a later date.
The amount of lost or deferred revenue.
